description: When Matt Hall ran for state representative, he faced strong opposition from the utility industry. Organizations linked to Consumers Energy spent hundreds of thousands of dollars trying to defeat him. Matt Hall prevailed—and since then, he has remained a strong advocate for affordable, reliable energy, local control over wind and solar projects, and lower energy bills for Michigan families.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Matt Hall for State Representative
title: LOWERING YOUR ENERGY BILLS - Matt Hall
